people.name: Anton Defranceski
people.role: The eldest of the six. Certified by the mayor of Pfullingen in 1950 as having worked for Hermann Sauer at Reutlingen-Süd.

people.name: Felix Defranceski
people.role: Single, at Pfullingerlandstraße, Reutlingen. Motor mechanic for Hermann Sauer from July 1941, then a driver for Wilhelm Heim, then back to Sauer.

people.name: Petar Defranceski
people.role: Ship's engineer with Jugoslav Lloyd at Split; left for Germany in 1939 to train and stayed. Married Luise Salzer of Neuhausen. Applied in 1947 to be resettled in California.

people.name: Zdravko Defranceski
people.role: Taken by the Partisans in 1943, held three or four months, then straight to Germany. Married Ruža. Resettled February 1949.

people.name: Ivan Defranceski
people.role: Entered work on 21 October 1941 at sixteen, as an unskilled hand at Licht und Kraft, Reutlingen. Returned to Croatia; the line continues through him.

people.name: Ruža Defranceski
people.role: Zdravko's wife, from the mountain village above the coast. No profession recorded.

people.name: Luise Defranceski née Salzer
people.role: Petar's wife, and the only German-born adult in the group. Married Petar in February 1942.

people.name: Three children
people.role: Born in Württemberg during the war and entered on the camp cards with the single word enfant written across the fingerprint boxes. Omitted here by name: they may be living.
